fusion_idea.correct_answer_plan: Determine complete diversity, then classify the damages into a joint, undivided component that can be aggregated across plaintiffs for AiC and separate components that cannot. Use the financial allocation to compute each plaintiff’s recoverable amount for AiC purposes (or the single joint stake if truly undivided) and conclude whether at least one plaintiff satisfies >$75k or a jointly held right exceeds $75k.
